name: crim-flight-deck
description: CRIM Flight Deck - tablet/phone flight controls for MSFS 2024

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @crim/server -- --dev" "npm run dev -w @crim/web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @crim/server -- --dev --adapter mock" "npm run dev -w @crim/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @crim/web && npm run build -w @crim/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @crim/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crim/server && npm run typecheck -w @crim/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke
